items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Oh, Johnny was with them kind of fellas.

ctx.x: It's shrill up there. Yeah, it don't fit. I don't like it much high. I don't like it high. See? Now you take Charlie, McCutty, George and Teo and them, they played out in the middle of that horn.
Johnny Dawes played some nice low register stuff.

You see? Because I'm talking about guys who played low register. I'm talking about guys who played low register, climate. He, see? Because I don't know. You see? Oh, Johnny was with them kind of fellas. You see, the fellas, what I'm talking about, played climate. Yeah. Old man Teo, old papa Teo. I played the level. When I played the last year, I played with old papa, I think he was around 90 some years old, still blowing his horn. George Fields, I think just died here lately. I think he's dead. Yeah, he died.
